description: List contacts (clients and suppliers) from Quipu. Returns id, name, tax_id (NIF/CIF), email, phone and address fields. Results are paginated: use `page` to walk through pages. Quipu returns JSON:API, but this tool flattens each resource so attributes appear at the top level alongside `id`.
